title: Transform panel: X/Y/W/H/rotation/skew inputs
description: Implement a Transform panel matching Flash 8's Transform panel. Shows exact X, Y, W, H (in px), rotation (degrees), and skew (horizontal/vertical degrees) for the current selection. Inputs are editable: typing a value transforms the selection. Constrain proportions checkbox for W/H. Reset button. Wire to selection change in Shell.tsx. See docs/02-tools-selection-transform.md for Flash 8 transform behavior. Place in a collapsible panel next to Properties.
